name: red-handed
description: Your agent said the tests pass. This checks that a test actually ran. Installing turns on two hooks: one strips the tail or grep that eats test results before a test command runs, one audits the session against git the moment it ends and warns only when something was caught. It also adds /red-handed:audit and /red-handed:history for asking directly. Everything runs locally over the transcripts already on this machine. No model calls, no telemetry, nothing leaves the machine. Uninstalling the plugin removes both hooks.
